panels.title: Untitled (Copy)
panels.text:
Bans Lurker
#####The ban lurker is a feature of Varnish that can help you keep a clean cache, by scaring seldom-accessed objects with long TTLs out into the open. Here they can be executed humanly by Varnish's flexible ban-purging mechanism. These objects would otherwise hide in the corners until their TTLs expired.
